column2: Young people are turning to AI after online harm: Youth Perspectives Survey 2025.
column6: Fetched: Thorn survey of ~1,000 US minors on their online-safety experiences and AI use; documents how youth USE chatbots after harm but does not test any named AI system's capabilities, behaviour, or safeguards, so no qualifying §1.0 finding by a named evaluator. Also post-cutoff (2026-07-31) but excluded substantively.

column2: As AI becomes part of kids' response to online harm, new Thorn research finds children turning to chatbots for guidance after online sexual interactions
column6: Fetched: press release restating the same Youth Perspectives 2025 survey; reports children's behaviour (15% sought advice from a chatbot) not an empirical evaluation of any named AI system's safeguards. No §1.0 finding by a named evaluator; also post-cutoff (2026-07-28).

column2: April 3 could create a dangerous gap in child safety across Europe
column6: Fetched: policy-advocacy interview about an expiring EU CSAM-detection legal exemption; cites a 2021 NCMEC reporting statistic but evaluates no named AI system. Opinion/plan, not a §1.0 finding.

column2: A UN Panel on the Misuse of Technology in the Exploitation of Girls
column6: Fetched: 2014 blog recap of a UN CSW panel discussion on technology and child exploitation; no AI model, no named evaluator, no empirical model finding. Not an evaluation.
